prompt: Fund textbooks and school supplies for girls in rural Balochistan
title: Every Page Counts
tagline: A full set of textbooks costs less than a dinner out. For a girl in Kech, it's the whole school year.
story: In parts of Kech district, girls' schools open with teachers but without books. Families who can afford one set share it between siblings, and the girls are usually the first to go without.
Our team buys official board textbooks, stationery and school bags in bulk from Quetta and delivers them with a local teachers' association, so every girl starts the term with her own set.
PKR 3,200 equips one girl for a full year. Sponsor a student, and we'll tell you exactly which school she attends.

impactUnits.label: Books, bag & stationery for a year

faqs.a: Seven government girls' primary and middle schools in Kech, chosen with the district teachers' association.
The curriculum changes often and used sets are usually incomplete. New, official sets stop girls being left behind.

faqs.q: Can I sponsor a specific grade?
faqs.a: Yes. Mention the grade in your donation note and we'll allocate your set to it.

whatsappPitch: 📚 PKR 3,200 = a full year of textbooks for a girl in Balochistan. NUST students are delivering 200 sets this term. Be someone's first page 💛
